subject: Outage impact & compensation proposal — Lumina inference failures
messages:
From: Samira Khan <ops@luminahq.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Rao <cfo@luminahq.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Production inference failures — 2hr outage window (logs attached)

Marissa,

We experienced a regression in Redwood inference endpoints yesterday that impacted our patient triage pipeline between 02:30 and 04:45 UTC (roughly 2 hours). Requests returned 5xxs and timeouts; we saw a 23% increase in p95 latency and a spike in errors for our main model route. This caused several queued jobs to miss SLA windows and required manual reruns.

I've attached a short extract of request ids and timestamps (lumina_incident_log_20260720.txt) and opened ticket INC-20260720-9987. From a procurement/finance perspective, this is material — please let us know how Redwood proposes to make Lumina whole (credits/trial extension/other remediation).

We need a clear remediation plan and compensation to present to our leadership.

-Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Ops, Lumina Health
ops@luminahq.com

--
Attachment: lumina_incident_log_20260720.txt (text, 48KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <ops@luminahq.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <cfo@luminahq.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Production inference failures — 2hr outage window (logs attached)

Hi Samira — thank you for the quick heads up and for attaching the request ids. I'm very sorry for the disruption — we take incidents like this seriously.

Immediate next steps:
- I'm escalating this to our SRE and account team (cc'ed).
- We'll prioritize the postmortem and share a timeline for root cause by tomorrow EOD.
- For compensation: I can put forward an initial goodwill proposal (tokens + trial extension) while we confirm scope. Can you confirm the rough order of magnitude of monthly token usage for the affected service route so we can size this appropriately?

I'll follow up internally and come back with a concrete package (we typically offer a combination of usage credits and a trial extension or free Dedicated hours for production-critical customers).

Apologies again — we'll get you a proposal ASAP.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Lumina outage — proposed compensation (needs quick sign-off)

Team — forwarding Samira's note and the incident log. Lumina is upset (rightfully) and needs a compensation offer to present internally. Quick summary: 2+ hour regression, major consumer of their patient-triage route. They are an active mid-enterprise account on a pay-as-you-go plan (deal LF-4821, ~1.2M tokens/mo on the affected route historically).

I'm proposing we offer:
- 60k token credit applied to their account immediately
- 1 month trial extension on Redwood Dedicated reserved capacity (to offset reliability concerns)
- 1 complimentary 2-hour SRE runbook review session (to rebuild confidence)

Rationale: balances making them whole without setting an outsized precedent; demonstrable operational help plus credits. 

Please reply with APPROVE / ADJUST / REJECT. If APPROVE, Stephanie, can you confirm finance sign-off and whether we need a DocuSign credit amendment?

Thanks — need internal sign-off within 4 hours so we can send an external offer to Samira and Amit.

-Marissa

Attachment: sre_postmortem_draft.pdf (draft; blinded)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumina outage — proposed compensation (needs quick sign-off)

Marissa — reviewed the logs and SLO telemetry. Root cause appears to be an autoscaler misconfiguration combined with a new kernel path that regressed memory reclaim under a specific request-size distribution. Impact window matches their reported times.

From the incident impact model: an outage of this shape and account usage suggests service credit in the order of 40-80k token-equivalent. Separate from tokens, a short Dedicated trial extension reduces their near-term reliability exposure and is high-value.

I recommend we:
- Offer 60k tokens (applied as account credit)
- Provide one month Dedicated trial (no invoice)
- Offer a 2-hr SRE session and one follow-up health check 30 days after the trial starts

I've attached a quick calc and suggested language for the external email. Fine to proceed but note finance will want the credit documented and limited to use on inference spend only.

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: impact_calc_LF-4821.xlsx (calc, 12KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumina outage — proposed compensation (needs quick sign-off)

Marissa — thanks for the clear proposal. APPROVE with small adjustment: please cap token credit at 60k (as proposed) and include an outbound credit memo (credit_note_LF-4821.pdf) that specifies tokens are for inference spend only, expire in 12 months, and require acceptance via DocuSign. Finance will countersign after the customer signs the credit memo.

Also authorize the 2-hr SRE session and the one-month Dedicated trial. No discount on future invoices.

Once you have customer acknowledgement, route the signed DocuSign to finance@redwood.ai for the ledger entry.

-Stephanie
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <ops@luminahq.com>, Amit Rao <cfo@luminahq.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0400
Subject: Offer: account credit + Dedicated trial to remediate outage impact — LF-4821

Hi Samira / Amit —

First, I'm very sorry again for the disruption the regression caused to your triage pipeline. We appreciate the incident log you shared — that helped speed our analysis. Based on the impact and internal review, Redwood is prepared to offer the following remediation package to make Lumina whole for the outage window: 

1) One-time account credit of 60,000 tokens (applied within 2 business days). Tokens are redeemable for Redwood inference spend and will expire 12 months from application.
2) One-month trial extension on Redwood Dedicated (no charge) starting on the date you accept the offer. This provides reserved capacity to reduce likelihood of recurrence.
3) One complimentary 2-hour SRE runbook review (Rishi will lead) plus a 30-day follow-up health check.

To accept, please sign the attached credit memo via DocuSign (link below). Once signed, we'll apply the credit and schedule the SRE session. Finance will post the credit after DocuSign completion.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rwd/credit/LF-4821
Support ticket: https://redwood.support/tickets/INC-20260720-9987
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/LF-4821

If you'd like a different structure (larger token amount vs. discounted invoice) let me know and we can escalate for executive review.

Appreciate your partnership — we'll continue to improve the runtime so this doesn't happen again.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
